(1) STEP 3b INSTRUMENT MISMATCH -- THE TABLE NAME IS MISLEADING AND SHOULD BE CORRECTED. The paper's Measures section says "Surface acting and deep acting scale were measured each with three items developed by Brotheridge and Lee(2002)" and gives the sample surface-acting item "Pretend to have emotions that I don't really have". The live sa1-sa3 items are NOT those items and are not about emotional display at all: they are S1 File questionnaire items 22-24, a three-item value-suppression block ("I suppress my own values when they differ from those of the organization", "My behavior reflects the organization's values, even if they are inconsistent with my personal beliefs", "I say things at work that I do not actually believe"). No Brotheridge & Lee wording appears anywhere in the 51 S1 headers, and the paper reproduces only that one sample item, so the study's actual surface-acting scale is not recoverable from the deposit. Two further checks agree that items 22-24 are not the analysed surface-acting block: the paper reports alpha=0.882 for surface acting, while columns 22-24 give alpha=0.690 on the 396 deposited rows (none of the deposit's block alphas reproduce the paper's reported values -- red tape 0.761 vs 0.883, negative emotions 0.394 vs 0.880 -- so the deposit appears not to correspond to the reported analysis, which is a response-data observation, not an item-text one). The three items are instead a near-verbatim parallel of Hewlin's Facades of Conformity scale (item 22 vs Hewlin's "I suppress personal values that are different from those of the organization"), which the paper never cites. Extraction therefore follows Step 3b and describes what the live data actually is: instrument is the descriptive "Qiang et al. (2025) frontline retail staff survey, value-suppression block (questionnaire items 22-24)", not "Brotheridge & Lee Emotional Labour Scale". The table NAME and the dictionary Description ("Surface acting / value-suppression scale") should be corrected -- flagged for the orchestrator; no row was written to pending_index_notes.csv from this agent.
